findings.why: The drawing in force (rev B) requires MAT-6082-T6 (EN AW-6082-T6) for BR-225. The proposed EN AW-7075 is a different grade, so it does not meet the drawing material. 7075 has no id in the glossary, so the key is the name as said in the meeting.

EN AW-7075 has no material master record and no id in the documents. Someone must supply its data, including yield strength against SC-BR225-YS (at least 250 MPa) and its suitability for the COAT-ANOD anodising.
